name: BLOOD SUGAR
source:
-Help Glaze With Her Dress-Up!-

A little novel with dress-up aspects, in which you help your old friend Glaze! She wants to look cute for her upcoming killing sprees until The Sugar Rush! 

And in return... She'll spare you! Isn't that a fair deal? ♡

[From [url=https://sacchariinee.itch.io/blood-sugar]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
-帮助格莱泽打扮她！-

一本关于装扮方面的小小说，你可以在其中帮助你的老朋友格莱兹！她希望在即将到来的杀戮狂欢中看起来很可爱，直到“糖热”！

作为回报……她会饶你一命！这不是一个公平的交易吗？♡

[来自[url=https://sacchariinee.itch.io/blood-sugar]Itch.io[/url]]
